title: Reviewer failures get osf-owned reasons, and a red job still reports
summary: A reviewer's raw output is untrusted text that can hold a credential, so osf now reads it and emits only a fixed category (credential, quota, model unavailable, schema rejected, unreachable, command line, permission, unknown) alongside the exit code and elapsed seconds. The new failure module classifies stdout and stderr together, JSON fields first and text patterns last, and every failure reason is scrubbed before it reaches the journal, SARIF or the saved run. A reviewer job that made attempts and none answered now writes its --out file first and then exits 2, so the artifact explains the red job; the workflow drops OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME and the reviewer-home artifacts, and the reviewer home is removed whole on every path out of a run. The posted verdict now follows the run's overall verdict: could-not-run posts COMMENT, never APPROVE, and an empty lens set is could-not-run rather than a pass.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: per-reviewer jobs
nodes.summary: Each reviewer job runs osf review run in a container, uploads its saved answers, and no longer sets OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME or TMPDIR, nor uploads a reviewer-home artifact.

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: A per-reviewer job that can now go red: osf review run exits 2 when the reviewer tried and nothing answered, after the --out file is written and uploaded.

nodes.label: final review job
nodes.subtitle: decides by quorum
nodes.summary: Runs after a red reviewer job and decides by quorum rather than by any single reviewer job's result.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Runs one reviewer, saves its run file first, then exits 2 when the reviewer never answered so the artifact explains the red job.

nodes.label: failure::classify
nodes.subtitle: Category from stdout + stderr
nodes.summary: Reads a reviewer's output and returns only a fixed Category. JSON fields (statusCode, status, api_error_status, error.type, error.code, code) are read first, plain text patterns last; a status number counts only with HTTP context.

nodes.label: reducer::decide
nodes.subtitle: weighted_mean + decide
nodes.summary: An empty lens set now yields no weighted mean and decides CouldNotRun at every threshold, so a review with no selected lens is never a pass.

nodes.label: review::plan_review_for
nodes.subtitle: verdict to posted event
nodes.summary: Maps the run's overall verdict to the posted event: Fail requests changes, CouldNotRun posts COMMENT, Pass or no overall verdict approves, and a blocking finding always requests changes.

nodes.label: answer::schema_for
nodes.subtitle: schema sent to harness
nodes.summary: Strips $schema and $id from the schema handed to a harness, and masks reviewer-chosen names in validation error paths via trusted_location.

nodes.label: review_run::ReviewerRun
nodes.subtitle: never_answered + scrub
nodes.summary: Adds never_answered (tried and nothing answered) and scrubs invalid/could-not-run reasons through redact_reviewer_text before saving.

nodes.label: reviewers::run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawn, drain, classify
nodes.summary: Spawns the harness, drains stdout and stderr, and on failure builds a reason from the exit code, elapsed time and failure category, never the reviewer's text.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: private home, removed on drop
nodes.summary: A private home directory removed whole on every path out of a run; the OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME escape hatch and forget_login are gone, and a home replaced by a link loses only the link.

nodes.label: reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: The child process osf drives; its stdout and stderr are untrusted text read only for a category.

nodes.label: provider API

nodes.summary: The external model endpoints whose 401/403/402/429/404 responses and error bodies the classifier recognises.
